title: Campaign for North Africa source catalog

coverage.summary: Main Organization-at-Arrival identity rows, all 124 national characteristic codes, 81 tank/gun chart rows, 102 aircraft configurations, 132 printed SGSUs, 20 naval counters and counter-only/support supplements. Shared illustrative sprites cover every catalog row. This is not a certified unique historical unit inventory or a playable campaign setup.
gaps: Initial formation TOE, morale, weapon mixtures, arrival/withdrawal dates, placement, readiness and supply inventories are not transcribed. No row is ready for playable scenario selection.
OA pages omit the three Italian divisions Sirte, Marmarica and Cirene that appear on counter p.182. Their 41 counter identities have no inferred characteristic profile.
Some attached, replacement and alternative-organization rows refer to the same historical unit. OA source rows are intentionally not deduplicated; entry count is not a physical-counter count.

Pz IIIE shifted chart cells, 7.62cm Pak and Marder III CPA, Cant Z506B range, Gladiator II fuel, German profile v close assault, and Italian profile pp aggregate TOE remain unresolved where the print is ambiguous or conditional.
Printed chart exceptions and parenthesized values require their rule context. This catalog does not implement augmentation, refits, combat formulas, aircraft mission eligibility or scenario rules.

Counter scans are present (physical pp.182–187); exact all-1800-piece reconciliation and identity aliases between charts and counters remain unverified. Generic administrative markers are not fighting units.

Sprites are generated/shared role illustrations, not unique historical portraits or source-counter facsimiles. Taxonomy/role labels are presentation metadata; original printed designations remain in source references.
coverage.source_review: Both supplied 192-page PDFs and docs/rules.txt inspected. Numeric authority is the scanned chart/counter, not damaged OCR. Profiles duplicated on pp.167–168/171 and weapon charts on pp.172–173 are not double-counted. Organization diagrams pp.135–136/174–175 are not additional deployment rows.
coverage.prototype_policy: Existing prototype HP/action points/fuel/water/ammo/morale values are not official CNA stats and are not copied into this catalog.

stat_definitions.name: Capability point allowance
stat_definitions.description: Base movement/combat allowance; not prototype action points. Motorization, attachments and fixed-CPA exceptions apply.

stat_definitions.name: Anti-aircraft rating
stat_definitions.description: Ability to attack aircraft. Not naval actual AA points.

stat_definitions.name: Barrage rating
stat_definitions.description: Indirect artillery fire rating before combat conversion. Not naval actual barrage points.

stat_definitions.name: Anti-armor strength
stat_definitions.description: Ability to destroy armored vehicles.

stat_definitions.name: Vulnerability
stat_definitions.description: Gun susceptibility in a forward position, incorporating range and tactical doctrine.

stat_definitions.name: Armor protection
stat_definitions.description: Ability to withstand anti-armor fire.

stat_definitions.name: Offensive close assault
stat_definitions.description: Offensive close-assault rating.

stat_definitions.name: Defensive close assault
stat_definitions.description: Defensive close-assault rating.

stat_definitions.name: Maximum TOE strength
stat_definitions.description: Table of Organization and Equipment capacity, not HP or arrival strength. Weapon-mix and attachment limits remain applicable.

stat_definitions.name: Basic morale
stat_definitions.description: Training, combat experience and esprit de corps, generally -3 through +3. Not transcribed as an initial formation stat here.

stat_definitions.name: Fuel rate
stat_definitions.description: Vehicle fuel-efficiency rate, not fuel carried or current fuel state.

stat_definitions.name: Breakdown adjustment
stat_definitions.description: Construction/maintenance adjustment: positive is a right shift (R), negative is a left shift (L), zero is no shift. Preserve chart/date exceptions.

stat_definitions.name: Aircraft range
stat_definitions.description: Maximum outbound mission leg and separate return leg. Transfer range may be twice this value.

stat_definitions.name: Tactical air combat
stat_definitions.description: Air-to-air combat rating; parenthesized ratings cannot initiate air combat.

stat_definitions.name: Maneuver
stat_definitions.description: Relative aircraft speed, altitude and agility used in combat differentials.

stat_definitions.name: Bombload capacity
stat_definitions.description: Bomb points, called tonnage by the rules but explicitly NOT actual tons.

stat_definitions.name: Torpedo capacity
stat_definitions.description: Torpedoes permitted by this aircraft load configuration.

stat_definitions.name: Aircraft fuel consumption
stat_definitions.description: Fuel required for one mission or emergency flight, regardless of distance; not fuel capacity.

stat_definitions.name: Naval gun rating
stat_definitions.description: Actual barrage strength and damage capacity, not a land-unit raw barrage rating.

stat_definitions.name: Naval AA rating
stat_definitions.description: Actual naval AA strength; reduces in proportion to gun-rating losses.

stat_definitions.name: Coastal shipping capacity
stat_definitions.description: Printed coastal shipping cargo capacity.

schema_notes: All source pdf_page values are one-based physical pages, never the rulebook printed folio.
verification describes transcription/identity confidence; each stat has independent status. Unresolved values are null, never zero.
Read profile_id only as a base-characteristics association. Do not merge profile values into an initial scenario unit.
Parenthesized sourced stats retain conditional=true and raw text. A sourced number can still require chart restrictions.
For directional sprites: visual rotation = desired_heading_degrees - native_facing_degrees. Headings are clockwise from screen east. Angles are approximate artistic estimates.
All entries have playable=false. Artwork is shared by role; see docs/unit-catalog.md.
